items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Who was always in the band then? Lee Collins, Tee Paul, Joe Reni, and myself.

ctx.x: Ask him who was in the band.

Who was always in the band then? Lee Collins, Tee Paul, Joe Reni, and myself. And I don't know. Let me see. Let me see what I saw. I'm going to... Who's George Washington ever had? Yeah. I'd love to have those records. You didn't know him, eh, George. He wasn't much taller than me. No, he wasn't. Then once we had a band, I don't know what the name was. George Washington, Tee Paul, Johnny, myself, the wrestler Don, and Joe Reni. All of us. All of us. All of us in the band was short. I was the smallest one in the…
Ask him did he make any records.
